reviews.author: WT Goldman
reviews.title: Unparalleled Service and Environment
reviews.text:
This is my third time coming to Paradisus Cancun. It’s by far the best all-inclusive resort I’ve ever been to. I always book their Reserve Adults Only section, it’s very much worth it. 

My butler, Omar Robledo, is among the main reasons I give this resort the highest of ratings. When I return, and I will very soon, I’ll make sure it’s Omar I get as my butler or I’ll walk away lol. 
He was very attentive, always making sure I’m getting the best of what the resort has to offer. Without him I would’ve missed out on plenty of goodies. Thank you Omar!!

A shout out also to other awesome staff members like Ivan and Horacio in the Reserve section that made sure I was well taken care of, along with all the beautiful smiling faces of all Paradisus staff always greeting you as you walk by. 
An unparalleled experience is what you’ll get in Paradisus.

reviews.title: Large property with many amenities but pushy sales model which becomes bothersome
reviews.text: The property is large including the beach, which allows you to spread out from crowds if wanted. Their staff members are very helpful, however, their new service model centered around the “Circle” membership creates frequent instances of members attempting to sell you their memberships. Nearly every hallway has team members stopping you and trying to sell you something. This did not occur nearly as often, if at all, last year. It made it hard to enjoy your vacation because of the frequent and constant conversations. There are a few good food options. Since they reopened just recently, we found they were out of many menu options and some restaurants were not operating during their listed hours, making it difficult to choose lunch/dinner.

reviews.author: Catharine M
reviews.title: Pros and Cons
reviews.text:
The hotel resort and amenities are beautiful. The pools were clean and wonderful, as well as my room. I upgraded to The Reserve (adults only) and was assigned a concierge, Manuel, who was wonderful and helped me book dinner reservations, the spa, etc. The drinks were great and the service was overall good, but here are some complaints I had: 

1. I found the food to overall be terrible. I had some good meals - sea bass, tilapia, and other fish, but everything else was barely edible, and it upset my stomach (and I have a strong stomach!)   Lemon Fish and Aqua Marina were good, but I didn't like any of the other restaurants. Sal Steakhouse I found to be very overrated and the service was not good (maybe because I was just one person?) Malva, the buffet, had good salad and fruit, but that was about it. Everything else was not good, and also not very warm. 

2. I found it frustrating that dinner reservations had to be made, and they were not easy (thank goodness for Manuel!)  Several nights the restaurants were booked until 8:30 or 9pm and I don't like to eat that late, so I was irritated that I was at an all-inclusive and my dinner times and locations were very limited. 

3.  The pools were lovely, but it would have been nice to have a swim-up bar at the adults-only pool and not just the family pool. 

4. It would have been nice to have bars where you could actually sit at the bar - better for socializing. But this resort did not have that so you just ordered your drink and left. 

I have stayed at only two other all-inclusive resorts in my life (all in Mexico) so I am not an expert, but the food was the worst I've ever had. However, the drinks were good and the grounds were lovely - the hotel, facilities, pool, all very nice. So it just depends on what is important to you.

reviews.author: Voyageur
reviews.title: Great vacation. Thanks to the amazing staff.
reviews.text:
An overall excellent vacation. Hotel is well situated. Very nice beach and view. Extremely clean. High quality food. Outstanding service from all the staff. Special mentions to: Breakfast team: Ramiro, Alberto and Fernando. Also, Jesus (that’s his name) at the Lemon Fish Restaurant.
Here are more specifics:

Room: I had a nice ocean view room in the main building. All comfortable. Cleaning service mostly come in the afternoon. The only drawback is that it was a bit noisy as it is overlooking the pool and all the entertainment. I think the reserve section maybe better if you need absolute peace and quite but they did not have ocean view rooms when I reserved. Overall, things go quiet after 9:00 pm.

Beach: Wonderful sandy beach but the ocean had a lot of waves during the time I was there but I still managed to enjoy it. They say March or April are the best time to come. You have to get up early, even before sunrise, to reserve. Beach chairs or parasols. By 7:00 am all are almost gone. That is one point that can be improved upon.

Food: There is the main buffet for breakfast, lunch or dinner and then there are various à la carte restaurants for dinner. The food is high quality and tasty. I had no problems getting dinner reservations during my stay. You can reserve a few days in advance. My favorite was «  Lemon Fish » which is a Japanese Peruvian fusion. Service at all restaurants was outstanding.

Would definitely go back!,

reviews.author: SweTee
reviews.title: Solo stay, loved the attentive service
reviews.text:
I stayed at this hotel as a solo traveller for 4 nights in a sea view room in the main pyramid. I absolutely love the inside of the hotel, all the plants, greenery and height of the main ceiling is a stunning first impression. 

I think the rooms are little tired looking but it didn’t bother me significantly, however the aircon is actually quite loud. Huge king size bed, the seats provided on the balcony were low deckchairs so my short self didn’t really enjoy the sea view when sitting down. The toiletries provided are good and included shampoo, conditioner, shower gel and body lotion which is a nice touch. If you want a quiet stay, the main pyramid is not for you as the evening entertainment and all the bar and restaurants are located there. 

Breakfast is great, although not so many seats outside (maybe because of the time of year I came) which is a shame as I want to eat outside wherever possible. Service is very attentive everywhere including on the beach. That was definitely a highlight! Staff are working hard and super polite and they deserve a lot of credit. Shoutout to Moses in the Mexican a la carte restaurant. Food in general was good. Had a couple of things I wasn’t too sure of but overall, better than some places I have stayed. 

I honestly can’t fault Paradisus as the gym is also amazingly big, the spa is nice, plenty of pool space and sun loungers. The beach could be maintained a bit better as some broken plates laying around randomly in the sand I guess form late night revellers but a pretty minor thing in general. I would love for them to update the rooms but overall there are some cute photo spots for Instagram, the decor is fun outside and I would return as even though I don’t have children it wasn’t crazy loud when I stayed. I have also stayed at Paradisus in Punta Cana and at other Melia hotels and not been disappointed so the chain is consistent!

reviews.author: Fernanda D
reviews.title: Unforgettable time at Paradisus, Cancun
reviews.text:
I had the opportunity to stay at Paradisus, Cancun for 6 days and without a doubt it was one of the best trips of my life.

I stayed in The Reserve - Adults Only area and it was totally worth it. They communicated with me prior to my arrival to arrange my transportation from the airport and ask about my preferences to start customizing my trip.

When I arrived, I could not stop admiring the beauty of the hotel as it has so much nature that it really makes you feel like you are in a pyramid or cenote. 

Upon arrival they assigned me to my concierge Rocio, who made me feel at home from the very first moment. She was super friendly and attentive to the objective of my trip. She took care of all the reservations for the restaurants, SPA and activities for me. I didn't have to worry about anything, it was literally a VIP experience, I only worried about enjoying and recharging my energy. She surprised me by decorating the room to celebrate my birthday and unforgettable details that make the difference. Truly, I could not have asked for a better concierge and would definitely recommend her to my contacts. Her knowledge and attention made my stay a pleasant one. 

The food in the restaurants is exceptional especially my favorites were Lemon Fish, Flora and Sal Steakhouse, the only thing I didn't like was the Buffet but I only went time and from then on every day I ate in a different restaurant. 

All the staff at The Reserve is great, but without a doubt my recognition goes to the staff at the Sante restaurant who do their best to meet your expectations and are attentive to you at all the time. The best aguachile/french toast I have ever tasted was definitely there.

I will be back very soon and I would definitely choose the same hotel and the Reserve area again.

The peace, the service and the views are indescribable.

reviews.author: Maria F
reviews.title: Great! I highly recommend it!
reviews.text:
Great! I went alone and took The Reserve option and it was great!

STRENGTHS:
- The view of the sea is the most impressive thing for me, I loved it! And you can see it from anywhere in the outdoor area.
- The location of the hotel is good. (This region is much more beautiful than Playa del Carmen, for example and is not that far from the center and the airport)
- At The Reserve I stayed in a quieter and quieter area, both in the rooms and in the pool (there is a pool for adults only), with the option of reserving beds on the beach at no cost (if the hotel is very full, you need to book), They let you do late checkout free of charge. Everything was perfect!
- There are several restaurant options and different types of cuisine. There's no catch, everything is really included (except lobster and meat in a specific restaurant that they warn you about beforehand). The food and presentation of the dishes is far superior to other all-inclusives I've been to, including those from the same chain.
- Includes really cool activities like crafts, yoga, wine tasting, etc., for both adults and children (For those who are at The Reserve, everything is free)
- One night there was a really cool Aladdin musical performance around the pool. They always offer different night shows.
- The entire team is very helpful
- At The Reserve you have a concierge to help you and book everything you need via WhatsApp.

NOT SO POSITIVE POINTS:
- Even taking the The Reserve option, the restaurants are together with the others, there is no exclusive area for eating, except for a cafeteria. But you have advantages for booking restaurants and so on.
- At first the resort was empty and it was easy to dine, but closer to the end of the year celebrations there started to be huge queues and restaurants reaching their maximum capacity for that day.
- Unless you have small children, I don't recommend the trip to the Cenote with Yoga and Shamanic ceremony, which is free in this package. I found it disorganized and quite a waste of time (it's like a dark lake with a small zip line, Yoga was a mini foot stretch and the ceremony was a quick smoke). They sell it as something incredible, but it isn't. This region has real Shamanic activities, real Yoga and other Cenotes that are much more beautiful (crystal clear and blue water) than this one, so I didn't think it was worth wasting a morning there.
- Just one day I left a sign on the door to clean the room and no one came, I don't think they read it and thought it was "do not disturb". Only after I removed the sign, at the end of the day did they come in and clean it.

IMPORTANT to say: None of the negative points diminish how pleasant it was to be there, how well I was treated and I loved staying at this resort, so it's a place I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Iris
reviews.title: Absolutely the Best Vacation Spot with the Most Wonderful Staff
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun - The Reserve is the only place I will stay in Cancun. Time and time again the staff and the surroundings bring me absolute joy and peace for a rare week of vacation!
First and foremost, I know I'm in the best hands, especially when traveling solo. I know I have great resources available to me and honestly, I never have to lift a finger. I feel as if I am taken care of the moment I step off of the transfer. 
Raul is always one of the first people to greet me at the door and always acknowledges me with a big "Welcome Back!" and "It's so nice to see you again, my lady!" He always puts me in the greatest of moods after a long morning of travel.
Ruth and Violeta, butlers from The Reserve, are amazing! They made sure my daily needs were taken care of. Ruth put me in the great hands of Violeta, while she took a well deserved vacation. Daily check-ins on all my needs was greatly appreciated. My dinner and spa reservations were all taken care of for me without fail! You would be luck to snag a week with either of these ladies!
Diego is the manager of Sante and The Reserve Pool. He is so lucky to be surrounded by such a hardworking staff! Jennifer and Nicole made my poolside experience wonderful. Always being greeted with a big smile and a good morning, as well as a welcome chat every now and then. The waitstaff from Sante/Reserve Pool are second to none! They anticipated my daily requests. They are so hard working and so accommodating to not just me, but all of the guests. I do not require much, but there are definitely groups that demanded a lot from them and it was always done with a smile and eagerness, as well as promptness. Kudos to Valeria, Miguel, Yamil, Joel, Rubin, and Oscar! 
At Cielo, you will get the warmest reception and assistance with your authentic Mexican dinner. This is my absolute favorite restaurant all of my domestic and international travels. Chef David, Moises, Jose, Filiberto, as always, took such great care of me and went above and beyond during my amazing meals with them! Such delicious and mouth-watering food that is made with heart!
Capella - Luis is your guy! He didn't hesitate when I wanted to try 2 different pastas! Had such great recommendations
At Malva (buffet)- you will encounter an amazing staff as well, who I felt honored, when they repeatedly saw me at different times, and always wanted me to sit in their area! You'll be greeted by the manager, Adriana, and the sweet hostesses: Amy, Sury, and Fer. Orlando and Armando were always quick to get me a table and took great care of me every time I was there for breakfast. Juan, Rafael, Joni, Arnulfo, Romero, Eduardo all took great care of me during my other visits there.
Sal is also a top favorite of mine. The manager welcomed me to the restaurant and got me seated right away. Ignacio was the amazing waiter who was quite attentive and prompt. Such great service!
From the moment I arrived to the day I left, I encountered so many warm, welcoming, and helpful staff in all the different aspects of the hotel. It is impossible to list all the others here as well. Thank you for taking such great care of me, again. A week at your hotel is my guilty pleasure that I exclusively plan every chance I get, because I know I can turn off my brain, relax, breathe, and take in the surroundings, culture, and care that Cancun has to offer. I will be hard-pressed to go anywhere else when I am there! I am forever grateful for the staff at Paradisus Cancun and can't wait to see everyone again!

reviews.author: Traveler17092523102
reviews.title: Be Warned -Worst Experience Ever!
reviews.text:
Before arrival, Otium could have been more courteous as I was trying to arrange the offered transportation to the hotel. Unfortunately, they kept hanging up the phone. 
I arrived at Paradisus and waited 30+ minutes to be checked in and rushed through. When I asked for details on the resort, I was told to read the card. 

The room view I purchased differed from what I received, and they could not accommodate it. In my room, the toilet ran nonstop, the power went out every morning, and the outlets stopped working, causing the refrigerator to leak. Imagine maintenance coming to your room every day. 

Housekeeping took items from my room, walked in on me naked without knocking, and just stood there taking a mental picture. 

I could not reserve half the restaurants because they were closed for the week. Moreover, finding a spot on the beach was challenging due to people holding places with towels. 

On the last day, I woke up late. My alarm did not sound because the power went out again! I called guest services, but they never came. I barely made my flight. 

I exercised much patience and consideration, but this prompted me to reach out to the guest services manager (ZANNINO, ROSANNA). She rushed through my concerns and promised to make things right and email me. 

I did not expect to be emailing for two months for what she offered. She never made things right or kept her promises and became verbally abusive, yelling at me over the phone. Because of this, I opted not to return.

reviews.author: Jordi28
reviews.title: Rafael from lemon fish was superb
reviews.text: Excellent sushi, and the chefs special dessert was the stuff of dreams. Rafael is an amazing waiter also! He knew everything about the food and was passionate about it too. This is the 3rd time I’ve eaten here in the last 7 days

reviews.author: Adventurer514906
reviews.title: Lovely visit at Mélia Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: The staff was very accommodating and friendly. The resort has a lot of comfortable space by the pool and the restaurants are varied in their offerings. I had a lovely room. Raúl my concierge tried to be helpful with everything. The staff at Malva was very good to me every morning from the Fernandas, greeting me, to Janeth, Atilano and Ignacio who helped serve me everyone was kind. Also, the staff at Lemonfish was very professional and quick with their service. I thank everyone especially those that I forgot to mention.

reviews.author: Mr.WorldWide
reviews.title: Raphael from Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Raphael and his professionalism allowed me to enjoy this dining experience. The food was excellent and the service complimented the evening very nicely. The sex on the beach was delicious. Overall, the atmosphere was great. There was a live band playing in the lobby which flooded the restaurant. Maybe a little too noisy at times but the meal was undeniably excellent.

reviews.author: Michelle J
reviews.title: “Welcome Home” to Paradisus
reviews.text: This was our 5th visit to Paradisus Cancun and we are planning 2 more next year! Violeta is an excellent concierge, always attentive and going above and beyond-even sending a check-in text on her day off, during our stay. The Reserve wait staff work hard to ensure your needs are met! We enjoy the quiet, serene atmosphere that tower 5, the Reserve Sante restaurant and adult pool offer. We met and fell in love with Moises, Joel, Cesar and Valeria our first visit. We get to know each of them more with every visit and they continue to treat us like family! This visit we met new friends who quickly became favorites too! Oscar, Luis and Lorena always took care of us at Sante for breakfast and lunch. Yamil, Rubin, Miguel and Mario served up great drinks around the pool. And Julio was always friendly and full of smiles, each night in the Tower 5 bar. Dinners were always nice at each restaurant, but Antonio at The Lunch Box was exceptionally wonderful! We were so full from all the food he kept bringing, but he didn’t want us to miss out on dessert, so he picked 2 of his favorites and had them boxed to go! We never ate any meals from the buffet, but it looked to have any kind of food you could ever want! We can’t wait for our next arrival and to be greeted by Raul saying, “Welcome home”.

reviews.author: Marilyn C
reviews.title: Lemon Fish Restaurant, Melia Cancun.
reviews.text: I had a great time here for my birthday. My server Rafael was the best! I was a little late for my reservation coming from my massage and Emmanual was gracious enough to fit me at the next seating. The food was really good. Especually the ramen with pork belly ans the vrabby sushi roll. My server Rafael gifted me a bottle of champagne and he had the chef make a really nice desert for me. 💜💜 I felt really special for my special day! Thank you!

reviews.author: Clinton R
reviews.title: Fantastic November Veterans getaway
reviews.text: Definitely a 5 all the way.  Did the all inclusive and the food and service was great.  Spent an evening to pamper myself in the Steakhouse (Sal), which was an extra charge, but worth the money.  The evening bazaar’s brought some interesting items right to the lobby, just make sure you count your pesos and dollars correctly.  Never a line to get drinks and plenty of open chairs around the pool, with several cabana rental options.  Will be back.

reviews.author: Destiny N
reviews.title: Absolutely perfect!
reviews.text: We loved everything about Paradisus! All the restaurants were amazing! Specially, Cielo. They did an awesome job for my husband and I celebrating our 2nd wedding anniversary. Moises and Adriana really made our dinner experience something to remember. They spent the time to make it really feel like an anniversary celebration dinner. Thanks to everyone and all the staff! Everyone is so helpful and nice here. Definitely will be coming back!

reviews.author: Chris T
reviews.title: Amazing dinner!
reviews.text: Miguel and Jorge were amazing! The service was very prompt and Miguel had some great recommendations! Definitely enjoyed how he explained everything on the menu. I would definitely come back again if he was the waiter!

reviews.author: LumiQ
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text:
Lemon Fish

Simply delicious! The Waiter César went over and beyond to accommodate my food restrictions and served me the best tuna tacos I’ve ever had in my life thanks to the Chef Karen. I can highly recommend this restaurant in regards quality in food and in service.

reviews.author: Phenomjet
reviews.title: Poor quality for 5 star prices
reviews.text: AC in room does not work woke up soaked in sweat told them twice and they never fixed it or moved me to new room!  Spa services total rip off over 200 USD for 75 min massage!  Restaurants are boring and lack entertainment in fact the entire hotel is boring and lacks entertainment.  It’s very dated and showing its age.  Poor design where you have to walk too far to get to your room and back.  Lacks water park type amenities at pool and entertainment at pool basically this place is old and boring with awful AC and food is ok at best.  Not a good deal for 400 a night.

reviews.author: Darlene S
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancún
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancún is an amazing resort.  My concierge Eliu has gone above and beyond, always checking in and immediately attentive to everything.  Gemma, the masseuse, made me melt.  Great pressure.  I wish I could have had a massage everyday.  Moises at Blue Agave & Cielo was great with his knowledge on tequila and made me feel like a friend. Cesar at Lemon Fish was perfecto on his recommendations.  He was so warm and genuinely kind, he made me feel like I was not dining solo. All the staff, and I do mean ALL the staff are friendly and helpful.  There never was a day that I wasn’t acknowledged by every staff person when walking by.  I have one more day left to go here in this paradise to update on.  I know it will be just as wonderful as everyday before it.

reviews.author: Toppie L
reviews.title: Deep cleaning facial
reviews.text: Liliana was superb! This was my first facial ever and she made me feel relaxed. It felt like I was having a facial massage 💆🏽‍♀️. There was even some neck tension ahe took away! I wholeheartedly recommend Liliana 👌🏼

reviews.author: Joe C
reviews.title: Lemon Fish Restaurant
reviews.text: Really enjoyed this restaurant. The green ship ceviche and black tuna sushi were my favorites. Also really enjoyed the salmon robatayaki. Rafael was my server and he was great too. Very friendly. Would highly recommend trying.

reviews.author: yusraa s
reviews.title: Love this place
reviews.text: This is my second stay and I have nothing but nice things to say. The staff is so friendly and welcoming, Veronica helped me with my reservations for the spa w d my cabana, Jorge by the pool was awesome and kept my drinks coming, Armando in Malva was so hospitable, I sat at his section every morning. Yesenia helped me on the beach, and kept checking on me. Because I went during the weekday, there weren’t many club things in the hotel. Last time I cam on the weekend, and there was a silent party and stuff. But that’s fine because I got much needed rest. Anna in the spa!!!! Wowww, that is all!

reviews.author: Nick G
reviews.title: Incredible service!
reviews.text: I travel all over Mexico and am extremely spoiled when it comes to All Inclusives.  Libni, the hostess was incredible and my Server Luis and Manager Carlos were absolutely top notch. I always stay at Breathless and Secrets but this hotel, staff specifically blew it out of the park. Chema, the food and beverage manager is the best of the best when it comes to Hospitality. I've stayed everywhere and there is no comparison. They made my entire stay with their unexpected Hospitality and I won't think twice when it comes to booking future trips.

reviews.author: Latisha J
reviews.title: Enjoying some me time!!
reviews.text: The Paradisus Cancun resort is fabulous!! The service and amenities are excellent!! Axcel with activities made sure I had an enjoyable experience!! If you are looking for a relaxing experience I definitely recommend 👌🏾

reviews.author: Kate O
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Alfredo Alvaro has been excellent at accommodating guests at the buffet. He is very attentive to all your needs while dining & very polite too. The food has been a great selection during breakfast, lunch, & dinner. Thanks for all the love!

reviews.author: Samantha P
reviews.title: Yhi Spa
reviews.text: First time at Paradisus Cancun and first time at Yhi Spa. I had a deep tissue massage and Leonor was AMAZING!!! Never have received a real deep tissue massage that was so comforting and relaxing. I definitely felt relief from the moment I walked out. 10/10 recommend. Her service was phenomenal.

reviews.author: Sasha G
reviews.title: Best massage at spa
reviews.text: Booked a Sensorial Escape for 75 min at the spa with Liliana. It was a wonderful salt and sugar scrub. Then I showered off the scrub and she massaged front and back. My muscles were happy and my mind was calm. Liliana is gifted. The essential oils and hot wraps were lovely. A major moodlifter. Give yourself permission to indulge. Fabulous!

reviews.author: Kema

reviews.text:

Photos by Fernanda at Outdoor Photos was an excellent experience. My photos are very professional and all of my family loved them. Please ask for Fernanda if you get photos!

reviews.author: Joe N

Thank you and I will definitely go back

reviews.author: Daniel K
reviews.title: Super bueno hotel y service es perfecto
reviews.text: I would like to thank Violetta and Wen for their super service during our stay. I loved everything about the hotel and i would love to come here again. Mexico treated me very nice. Also the restaurants were good, comparing it to other hotels.

reviews.author: Leonard M
reviews.title: Amazing Service, Amazing Food, Amazing People! The resort is amazing!
reviews.text:
The service in this place is Amazing I go on vacations for great service and food and this resort marks all the of it! Highly recommend The Reserve package! 

The restaurant by the pool (on the reserve side) has this amazing manager his name is DIEGO DIAZ! reviews.author: Luis Franco
reviews.title: A must-stay resort in Cancún
reviews.text: Amazing resort, delicious food, staff is very friendly, the beach and hotel grounds were clean. Thank you for your hospitality, you really made my stay memorable I’ll definitely will come back soon!!!

reviews.author: M_Akp
reviews.title: Unsanitary & Stingy
reviews.text:
If you are even considering booking here, for the sake of your vacation, please keep looking. I have traveled to Mexico every year for the past 5 years and this was by far my worst experience and it’s not even close.

I’ll preface this by saying I stayed at a Melia property in Cabo San Lucas, a 4 star, which was absolutely amazing so naturally I expected nothing less from their Cancun 5 star location. That proved to be a mistake.

This resort is dirty, has a poor smell, the rooms are poorly cleaned, you are nickel & dimed for everything the minute you get to the property, and their service is horrible.

Starting at the beginning — check-in. They are constantly trying to up-sell you for higher priced rooms, services, etc. They offered a “luxury” room for an extra charge of $260. I negotiated it down to $180. Fine.

Upon arriving to the room, I immediately notice a dingy, dirty looking rug in the seating area. Stained throw pillows on the bed, and stuck-on food on the spa brochure (shown)

I went downstairs and asked for a new room, hoping that had just been an isolated incident. They check me into a new room. 
Same thing — dirty rug, stained pillows and this time I even found a blonde hair in the bedsheets. I have black hair. 
Even more disgusting — I turned over the comforter and found a dried yellow liquid stain on the inside (pictured). 
I was absolutely horrified, especially with the serious concerns over coronavirus and the spread of germs. 

From then on, every minute I spent in the room was miserable, wondering what had actually been cleaned or replaced and what hadn’t. That is no way to spend a vacation you spent your hard earned money on. 

I expressed my concerns to their management and I was told that they “looked into their housecleaning processes and found nothing wrong”. 
They offered absolutely nothing to remedy the situation. 

In addition, the nickel & diming was pathetic for a so-called 5 star resort. Never have I been to an all-inclusive resort that charged for room service, especially since it’s the only food option after the restaurants and buffet close. They charge $5 per order and the best part — there’s a good chance your order will be wrong, as mine was all 3 times I ordered.

They also charge a whopping $200 per day to use their beach beds. You are forced to a purchase a “package” which includes a bottle of champagne. Tough luck if you don’t drink
I guess. 

Also, you will be turned away at their restaurants if you don’t make a reservation even if there’s barely anyone there. 
And to top it off, the food is extremely mediocre, except for the taco restaurant. 

In short, it seems at this place their goal is to make your vacation as difficult and expensive as possible. With emphasis on the latter. 

There are too many resorts in Cancun with way better value to waste a minute of your vacation or spend a penny of your hard-earned money here. 

But if strangers’ hair and unidentifiable stains in your bed, and poor food and service sounds like your dream vacay, then book away!

reviews.author: Ralph S
reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: A wonderful experience with great pool, service, and food. Special people Daniel, Norma and all the waiters. They are the best. Make you want to come back. Anything you need help with, they are very happy to assist you

reviews.author: Peter F
reviews.title: First Time at Paradisus - Flying Solo!
reviews.text:
After a 2 week research/work trip to Cobá for University, I decided to spend an extra week in Cancún and take a relaxing vacation. This is my 5th time to Cancún, 4th time at a resort, but first time at Paradisus. I chose the hotel based on reviews from Trip Advisor, Google, and other websites. Let me say, it exceeded every expectation I had for it. Totally blew it out of the water. From the second you walk in here they make you feel like a VIP and treat you like royalty. And I didn’t even get the Royal Service (which I’ve heard is magnificent, by the way). Every aspect of this trip was splendid. The check-in was fantastic, the food was top-notch, the activities were out of this world, and there was so much to do around the resort!! They really like to pack it in here. I stayed for 8 days and seven nights and I’ll quickly review the benefits of the resort below.

Food: pretty sure I made it to all the restaurants except Fuego. All of them amazing. Make sure to call and get reservations ahead as they book up fast, Vento is Mediterranean style, Mole is upscale Mexican (was my favorite one), Enso is Asian Fusion (Peking Duck was scrumptious), Bana is Japanese/Sushi, and Malva is the all you can eat buffet. Honestly have not had better food at an all inclusive before.

Drinks: good and strong. The Bartenders are great. Not much else to say here! They’ll pretty much make you anything you want and have top shelf stuff at most, if not all, of the bars.

Room: very nice. I had the Junior Suite with an Ocean View. The cleaning staff was wonderful and tended to every need that I could ask for. The view was incredible. I stayed in Pyramid 1 Club Meliá, which was very nice when I wanted quiet and away from the hustle and bustle of the main pyramid. Not a negative, just a comment, but the rooms could use updating in the near future, but it looks like they are currently working on that as they have some minor construction projects happening. This did not affect the stay at all. The only issue I had was connecting to the WiFi when I first checked in, but they promptly fixed this within a few minutes of me calling reception, and I didn’t have problems the rest of my stay. Additionally, the fridge/minibar in my room stopped working later one evening, and maintenance staff was up to my room within the hour changing out the fridge for a new one. Bravo service, really.

Spa: GO TO THE SPA!! It is incredible. I believe it is included in the Royal Service Package (which I didn’t have), but I did receive a complimentary spa day package (massage included!) for attending one of the 90 minute Meliá sales presentations. Absolutely 100% worth it. I went to the sales presentation my first morning here, they were not pushy in the slightest, was unable to purchase the package they were offering (even though I wanted to as it was an enticing deal, but I am a college student on a budget), and received my spa day certificate afterwards. The Yhi Spa is incredible. The massage was EVERYTHING and David my masseuse had magic hands. Everything about the spa was amazing.

Entertainment: absolutely, utterly fantastic. They have schedules of entertainment in the lobby or available right on the Meliá app so you know what is happening throughout the day. I did so much while I was here! Went to spinning class, did a personal training session, went to the spa, water yoga, aquaerobics, Zumba, watched a Brazilian Capoeira performance, went to a silent disco party, went to a guacamole making class, learned how to make margaritas, and so much more!! They honestly have something for everyone here. And the gym facilities ‘Yhi Moves’ is top notch, especially for a gym at a hotel/resort.

Ambience/Facility: utterly breathtaking. Wow, wow, wow. I walked in and my mouth dropped. I honestly didn’t know what I walked into. This place is probably bigger than some small towns. There is so much here and it is spectacular both inside and out. The pictures you take of it don’t do it justice. The beach is sparkling white and there’s not a drop of seaweed. The pools are so clean and maintained. The vegetation inside and out is breathtaking. The atmosphere and aromas here are wonderful. Really an experience for all the senses. 

People: obviously, and finally, I couldn’t forget all of the amazing people I met! Traveling alone I was a little apprehensive, but knew I would make some new friends. I met some wonderful guests who became fast friends, but more importantly, the staff here is absolutely incredible. Every single person I have come in contact with is incredibly kind, sweet, helpful, respectful, friendly, and wants to tend to your every need. I have a few shoutouts in particular that I want to give. These people went above and beyond my already exceeded expectations and really made me feel extra special, and developed that stronger relationship/friendship with me as a guest. They are amazing and deserve awards/raises/promotions/vacations/etc.: Alan from activities, Augustin from the gym and activities, Ruth at Club Meliá reception, Norma at the Concierge desk, Julio from the gym, David a masseuse at Yhi Spa, Edgar from the gym and Yhi Spa, Laura one of the attendant’s at the main pool delivering drinks, and Jaime our bartender for the Margarita class. All of these people really made my experience here extra special.

I think that covers my stay here at Paradisus Cancún. I am terribly sad to be heading back to the freezing cold and snow filled Buffalo today, but that only means I’ll have to come back and visit again soon. I hope you find this review helpful!

reviews.author: Jeff C
reviews.title: Over priced, horrible customer service, poor food quality
reviews.text: There are too many great options in Cancun to waste your money on this hotel.  There service is two or three stars at best.  The food is two stars.  But the price is five stars.  Save your money and try another hotel.

reviews.author: Alan T
reviews.title: Solo
reviews.text: Enjoyable solo experience at Paradisus.  Had some rime to explore areas outside the hotel along with amenities of the resort.  I visit Cancun often and always go back to Paradisus.  Recommend this resort to others!

reviews.author: Relax48804414142
reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: Out of the dozens of resorts I've utilized in Cancun, this is by far the best. Service, food, cleanliness, atmosphere is top notch.  I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a resort in Cancun and I cannot wait to go back.

reviews.author: Daniel S
reviews.title: White sandy beach & shades of blue water
reviews.text: My stay at Paradisus Cancun was very enjoyable. The hotel is spacious & well laid out, the staff cheerful & attentive, & the food varied enough to satisfy most palates. The rooms have great balconies, mine even had a jacuzzi.. There are terrific pools & a wide sandy beach.

reviews.author: Patrick G
reviews.title: Always A great Hotel
reviews.text:
I have been visiting this hotel since the early nineties. the beauty of the architecture, the incomparable Atrium lobby, the immaculate beach and the beautiful pools make the Paradisus a true paradise on earth. The best thing and the reason I return is the service from beach waitresses Asuncion and Leticia. 
If heaven is not like The Paradisus Cancun I will be VERY disappointed.

reviews.author: Tennisgirl14
reviews.title: Beautiful Day in Paradise
reviews.text: I've been coming to this resort for the last 4 years and I've always love it. Staff were all very friendly and they go above and beyond everything. Rooms are clean. Food was good with a lot of selection. Spa was treatments were also great. Beach was beautiful.

reviews.author: Rick D
reviews.title: Cooking Classes (Ceviche, tacos and salsa)
reviews.text: Erika, Guadalupe, Saul & Julio were great in this class, not only was the food amazing, but I have now learned how to make it, it was an incredible experience and these guys are the best instructors. Don’t miss out on this great class if you’re at Paradisus Cancun

reviews.author: Joan M
reviews.title: Paradisus is Paradise
reviews.text: I have been coming to Paradisus Cancun for 15 years.  I have  never been disappointed!  Hotel is beautiful, clean, the staff is treats you like family, the food is excellent with many restaurants to choose from.  There is live entertainment in the evening and the Red Lounge opens at 10 pm for dancing.  24 hour free room service and a mini bar in your room.  My favorite restaurant is Vento, which is Tapas with a large selection and really gourmet food.  Bani is great sushi and more.  Mole is upscale Mexican and very good.  These are my favorites.  Naos the buffet is also very good and the wait staff is very attentive, as they are in all restaurants.  Please be sure to tip these people as they really deserve to be.

reviews.author: odpbeta
reviews.title: Royal Service is worth staying
reviews.text: The experience of this service is exceptional.  I would save money for my family as it is worth it.  Beach is wonderful, palapa and service is on point, breakfast in the morning at the palapa is wonderful.  Spa service is exceptional as well.

reviews.author: Eric W
reviews.title: First visit to an All-inclusive....lots of lessons learned.
reviews.text:
Mixed experiences here. Was under impression from Travelocity ad for it that it is 18+ (the "Royal Service" aspect), but that is only 1/4th of the property. The rest is family, so I felt somewhat misled. The bulk of the restaurants on-site were in the family section of the resort, and every meal I had in one of those spots, regardless of the quality of the food, there were screaming/yelling children everywhere where the parents just let them do it. 
I was not greeted when I got to the hotel, I was mis-directed to the general check-in (not the "Royal Service" I should have been sent to), and stood 45 minutes waiting to get to the counter. When I got up to the staff, he immediately saw that I should have been taken to the Royal Service portion of the hotel at which I was redirected. 
      The site is beautiful, and I was MOSTLY treated extremely well by staff. But the energy of the place does not seem to lend itself to "socializing" (couples and small groups basically stuck to themselves), so I was left to myself for virtually the entire trip (and I am a pretty social guy).
Note that the rooms have a LOT of ambient light that gets brighter the darker the room gets (at night) that can only be turned off by killing the master light switch- however that kills ALL the electricity in the room, so the alarm clock won't work, you cannot charge phones/ipads during the night, etc..Also, I was never made aware that the cabanas by the pool and beach need to be reserved in advance (which makes sense), so when I arrived on a Monday afternoon, nothing was available on paper until THURSDAY (and I was leaving Friday). In fairness, Tuesday and Wednesday I was on a waiting list and was able to get one, but it is not a guarantee. The food was hit and miss. Some things were delicious, others were very basic.(They had a seemingly difficult time with "medium rare" meat. It was either VERY medium well, or almost raw).  One of the perks is you get a free bottle of booze when you arrive, so I was set with Rum and Cokes in my room for the week. Like I said its a beautiful site, but if you are looking for a vacation that is truly 18+, this isn't likely the best place for you.

reviews.author: quincyawilliams
reviews.title: Fitness Vacation Exchange Experience
reviews.text: I went to visit for a week April 14th - 21st and it was the best vacation I've taken! I went down as a group fitness instructor and for vacation. Everyone was so helpful. The resort stayed spotless and the food (especially Fuego) is amazing. It's also close to lots of shopping on 5th st.  If you're a group fitness professional and looking to get away while still teaching, I highly recommend Paradisus at La Perla and book with Fitness Vacation Exchange!!

reviews.author: David S
reviews.title: Going there for 7 years running!
reviews.text: I just returned from an 11-day visit to Cancun, staying at the Paradisus Resort for the seventh year in a row.  Overall, I have been very pleased with the place, and always look forward to my yearly return there.  That being said, I must express SOME disaffection with a few things.......Firstly, the place is beginning to show its years, and is very much in need of some serious make-over work.  Not a major overhaul, but definitely things like tile repair, installation of new stronger shower heads with greater pressure, and DEFINITELY an improvement in the cuisine!  I was on the "all inclusive" plan, and found that the quality of the food was seriously lacking.  Dinner meat was chewy and lacking in taste.  Breakfast pancakes were barely warm, as were the scrambled eggs, making for not-the-greatest start to the day!  The service at the hotel was EXCELLENT, as all the personnel were helpful, friendly, and ready to assist. I must single out several people for special praise.......Marisa and Christian at the breakfast reception, Leticia and Jesus at the pool, and Mekly, the Concierge........all of whom provided friendly efficient service that was especially worth noting. The pool deck and beach area are a definite plus!  As I said, a very enjoyable experience, which I hope to repeat next year........if needed improvements are hopefully enacted!

reviews.author: fransvan0
reviews.title: Are you under 14 ?
reviews.text:
Location, infrastructure, architecture, design, room comfort = 10/10.
ICT (pre-check in, registration, customer monitoring, invoicing, check out) = complete chaos. How does this hard working amiable front office desk staff (there are 10 of them) manage to cope with this situation, day after day ?
Must be paradise for the children, but for those over 14 you should pay 10 % extra and book Royal Service Exclusive in order to avoid the beehive.

reviews.author: eggz716
reviews.title: traveled solo to paradise!
reviews.text:
I had a great time on my solo trip to Paradisus Cancun! I'll break my review down into sections to make it easier. 

Transportation: I booked my whole vacation through Expedia, including my shuttle.  I used Super Shuttle.  I had a shared shuttle from the airport to the resort, they were punctual and courteous.  It was about $15.  No trouble finding them at the airport.  My tip would be to confirm your reservation with them 24hrs before you travel.  I booked my return shuttle to the airport at Paradisus Cancun.  They have an Expedia desk on the 2nd floor with Expedia staff members.  Apparently I had a return shared shuttle included in that $15. The pick up time was 4 hrs before my flight departure so I chose to upgrade to a private shuttle for another $20, this had a pick up time of 3 hours before my flight departure. I again confirmed the day before I was leaving.  I was picked up at the resort right on time, no issues getting to the airport. 

Check In/Check out: very easy and seamless.  I booked an ocean-view room.  Originally was given a room in pyramid 3 (main central building) on the first floor, i asked for a higher floor and took pyramid 4 on the 4th floor.  I do not regret it! I had a beautiful view and pyramid 4 is not that far! took me 5 minutes to get to any of the restaurants from leaving my room.

Room: Clean, well kept. I had 2 double beds even though I traveled solo.  The beds were a little firm for my taste but not a dealbreaker.  I know I had turndown service at least twice a day because I would notice my messy bed remade all the time :) Bathroom was clean and spacious, i loved the overhead rain shower! I also was able to adjust the temperature and fan to my liking.  The balcony was beautiful with 2 pool chairs and a stunning view of the beach and pool.    

Royal Service: I did not get Royal Service, but i do not think i missed much other than a royal service section of the pool.  For me I didn't think it was needed. 

Dining: For breakfast/lunch i ate at Naos the main buffet place.  Plenty of options to choose from.  For dinner you have a variety of restaurants.  I ate at Bana, Mole, and Vento.  My tip: make reservations the day BEFORE you want to go, call the front desk in the morning, they can start taking reservations at 7am the day before! I even made a reservation for my very first night by calling the day before i arrived.  I had didn't have any trouble getting the time I wanted, it also may be because it was just myself.  There were plenty of variety in the cuisine.  I enjoyed everything I ate. 

Pool: I didn't use the pool but there is a nice pool bar.  They also had shows around 8:30pm every night by the pool which was nice.

Beach: Turqoise blue waters and white sand beaches! There was not much seaweed either which was a plus.  You could go sort of far out into the ocean without it getting to deep.  I did rent a cabana on the beach for the day (10am-5pm).  There are different price levels of the cabana ranging from $130, $150, $180 for the day.  I did the $130, the only difference is how far you are from the water and whether you want lobster.  I was in the back row of cabanas and did not care for lobster so i picked the $130 one.  They serve you lunch from Coco's Beach Club, unlimited water, drinks, and a bottle of champagne :) I also got up early to reserve my beach chair, i think people start around 7am.  I reserved one around 8:30am without difficulty.  

Excursions: Aquaworld has a desk right by the beach/pool so you are welcome to explore.  I actually booked parasailing through the Expedia desk at the resort which they said was $8 cheaper.  Expedia booked it through Aquaworld too and gave me a ticket.  It was called "Sky Rider" so parasailing was done in a little couch-like boat rather than your feet dangling.  It was wonderful! The pick up was at the resort next door so just a 5-10 minute walk down the beach to their tent.  I was taken to the boat on a jet ski, parasailed for 15 minutes then taken back to the tent.  

Entertainment: They had a variety of shows, singers, bands every night either in the main atrium or by the pool.  I enjoyed a little bit each day. 

Overall I really enjoyed my time there! I would definitely return again!!

reviews.title: Awesome Employees and Service
reviews.text:
I want to thank the Club Melia employees who always give the extra mile to make you feel wonderful and treated like family. Thanks to Betsy, Fabiola, Karina, Ruth, and the Butlers Brayant and George. Also, I want to thanks Ivette who manage and serve an excellent team.

reviews.text: Great hotel!  Staff is excellent.  Hotel is beautiful.  I have stayed in this hotel many times and it is like a second home.  The food is outstanding.  The views are magnificent.  Hotel is very clean.  For the price, this hotel has the best value.

reviews.author: Irena
reviews.title: 7 days in November
reviews.text:
about 15 minutes from Cancun airport, 
check- in & out was  very quick and easy 
oceanfront room allowed to keep balcony open to hear waves,
all necessary amenities were provided, everything was working.
beach is great for walking along the ocean or relaxing,

reviews.author: Irena
reviews.title: Enjoyable expirience
reviews.text:
We've been visiting this place many times for the last 10 years, and always enjoy it.
Every time we come we see some changes for the better.
It's always great to walk along the ocean or just relax with the sound of the wind and waves. Sunrise and sunset are great.

This time I decided to visit all the classes and see all  the small & big shows.

Especially I loved Bosa trio and 2 singers at 2 different days that i do not remember the names. it' a great idea to have this intimate shows.
From the big ones I liked the circus, and now it's outside, big relief.
Andrea from entertainment staff was great by helping to translate and help me to visit all the classes.
 All of them are great, my favorite was with sommelier Iran Cervantes.
His knowledge and ability to explain and make you feel are greatly appreciated.
  Making some guacamole class was fun also.
I would like to thank all the staff at club melia who made the check in & out process just a breath, and was helping every day with different staff with a smile and understanding.
Great thank you to my butler Ana who was always there to be sure that everything is going great, and George- Jorge J Salinas,  who was our butler when we visited 6 months ago, and recognized me and went above and beyond to help, despite he had  other people this time.
Had an enjoyable experience at Tempo, exquisite  presentation, testing menu helped to realize what to order.

reviews.author: Rcain_LUV_2travel
reviews.title: Fantastic service and stay
reviews.text:
Absolutely loved my stay at the Paradisus. This is my 6th visit to Cancun and first time with this chain and I was pleasantly surprised. This is my favorite hotel now. 

The staff was very attentive in every aspect. From the hosts and wait staff at restaurants, to waiters at the pool to maintenance. Everyone was very pleasant and helpful. The grounds were kept immaculate. My room was very clean and looked new (I stayed in building 3). The food at the buffet was outstanding. The only slight was the food at the Japanese restaurant, it was bland and not much to it. The wait staff was very attentive. 

At the Mediterranean restaurant my waiter was ok but the host was outstanding. They didn't have pinot grigio at the restaurant and he took it upon himself to go to another bar and get it for me. I was traveling/dining alone and little things like this left a very positive impression. 

The pool was huge and clean. There were even shows poolside during the afternoon which I really enjoyed. At many all inclusive resorts it can be difficult to get a waiter while lounging near the pool. That wasn't the case here. I had a wonderful gentleman (can't remember his name). I'd hand him a $5 bill and he would come around for the rest of the day. He was always pleasant and helpful if I needed to find a chair, which could be difficult to find later in the morning. 

The fridge in the room actually kept my drinks COLD. It's rare, even in hotels in the states, most are barely cool. Beverages were restocked daily and there were snack too! The towels in the room are bath sheet size. Those are huge if you've never used them. No mold or bugs anywhere. They even have disposable drawer liners in the drawers. That way you're guaranteed fresh drawers to put personal items in. 

The grounds were immaculate, well kept and beautiful. There are real flower arrangements throughout the resort. 

I vacationed solo but checked out the kids area for possible future travel. They have 2 kid's areas divided by age. Babies to kids age 5, and 5-12. Unfortunately it is quite the age difference but I still see my son having a great time; he's 4. There's a building near there that has family suites and concierge. The children's pool is also there. It's 2 feet in depth with build in sun lounge chairs. It's a perfect depth for my son to play in since he doesn't know how to swim.

Highly recommend this resort. Great quality and value.

reviews.author: kevinpB5858IS
reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: Just stayed at the Paradisus Cancun for the second year in a row and equally satisfied the second time.  Great and relaxing environment.  I would highly recommend trying their Royal Service if you are going without kids.

reviews.author: Carlos C
reviews.title: Wonderful Spring Break
reviews.text: I spent my spring break at Paradisus Cancun. I was at the royal service part of the hotel. This is a really worth update if you are traveling without kids and you are looking for a relaxing VIP experience. It actually feels like you are staying in a different hotel. One of the highlights of this hotel is the quality of its restaurants. You will be highly surprised by their high cuisine. I totally recommend this it.

reviews.author: Patrick G
reviews.title: consistently excellent
reviews.text: I have reviewed this hotel before.. and the hotel has not changed.. my room was very clean and very comfortable. The maid service was attentive to detail and thorough in cleaning the room. The pool is expansive and ultra clean. THE BEST THING ABOUT THE HOTEL IS THE SERVICE. Asuncion and Leticia and the rest of the beach service crew go out of their way to make the Paradisus your paradise in Mexico.The beach is huge and immaculate.. I was looking for any bit of garbage ( (while looking for shells) on the beach and couldn't find any. Once again the hotel plays EXTREMELY loud BOOM BOOM MUSIC. ( IT ANNOYS EVERYONE ) but the beach is so big you can and should get away from the NOISE. I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Roland T
reviews.title: Excellent Hotel
reviews.text: I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at the Paradisus Cancun over four nights in March 2017.  The hotel is esthetically beautiful and the staff so friendly and welcoming.  I came here for rest and relaxation and that is exactly what I got.  The wait staff at Naos Restaurant were terrific but one particular gentleman, Orlando, deserves special recognition.  This gentleman was always upbeat, energetic, and enthusiastic about his job.  He embodies the spirit of outstanding customer service and it was always a pleasure to see him.  What made Orlando special is that he would anticipate your needs.  He would fit right in at a high end restaurant anywhere in NYC.  He was playful with the children and friendly with every one of his customers.  If possible, ask for a table with Orlando and he will take really great care of you.

reviews.author: jsl898
reviews.title: Best in Cancun
reviews.text:
My original booking was for the Iberostar Grand Paraiso in Playa Del Carmen, but I arrived one day early to avoid a storm. Looking for places to stay the night in Cancun, I came across Paradisus which offered an Ocean Front all-inclusive room for $190. Seemed way too good to be true, but I booked it anyways.

It wasn't too good to be true, Paradisus delivered! The room was absolutely beautiful, with sweeping views of the ocean. Everything felt so modern and clean. The beds were very comfortable and the bathroom was marbled.

The pool was warm and big, it was so fun to swim from end to end! The beach was stunning, with white sand and crystal clear blue water. It was a wonderful way to enter paradise.

The hostess at the Market Grill gave me a very last minute reservation, and sat me directly by the ocean view. I couldn't believe my luck. Then my dinner was made perfect by Armando and Efrain, who were the two nicest and most professional waiters I've ever met. They were so full of fun energy and excited to tell me all about the resort. They made me feel at home.

The breakfast was great too, tons of options. Unfortunately I left shortly after, but I was super impressed by this experience! I think my cheap price may have been due to the last minute (same day) reservation, but I'd gladly return for twice the $$$. Thank you for the awesome preview of the Paradisus, I'll be back!

reviews.author: Arlene Miskar
reviews.title: the three s's
reviews.text: I arrived I was greeted by beautiful smiles and warm and friendly people the hotel was amazing with all the greenery   there was always someone cleaning something all the time. the food was great the drinks were wonderful the room was clean and had an ocean view.  the ocean and deck chairs were fabulous

reviews.author: Adrian M
reviews.title: 6 out of 5 stars if I could!!
reviews.text: From the minute I arrive until my checkout (I stayed for 5 days as a birthday treat from Jan 28 - Feb 2), Paradisus treated me like royalty! Royal Service is just that and more! My butler during my stay, Gerardo, was simply amazing! The man took care of anything and everything I needed and went above and beyond any style of service I've ever experienced in my life! I stayed in the Junior Suite with the Lagoon View and the room/view was immaculate. The entire staff in the Royal Service area were very nice, cordial, and caring. The service I got at the private pool area anytime I went there (which was every day haha) was truly remarkable. Carlos, Cesar, Eduardo, and Victor went above and beyond to ensure all my needs were met; whether it was speedy service for drinks and snacks from La Palapa, ensuring I had a Bali Bed booked for the next day, to adjusting the Bali Beds so I could overlook the Caribbean Sea (and mind you, THEY suggested this for me, I didn't even have to ask), safe to say I was beyond spoiled. To add to that, on the day of my birthday, Gerardo had room service deliver a bottle of champagne and a beautiful slice of chocolate cake to my room, then the staff at La Palapa surprised me with a slice of cake and some tequila shots to wash it down as well! The restaurants were great: Market Grill and Blue Agave were my standout favorites. I splurged a little on a massage at Yhi Spa (Royal Service guests get the hydrotherapy service complimentary and I HIGHLY recommend taking advantage of it) and that was the best 80min I've come out of the pocket for in quite some time! I've never done an all-inclusive trip before and after my experience with Royal Service, I can't recommend it enough (Trust me, it's well worth the extra money to get). I WILL be booking another stay here later this year (or at the least, for my birthday) and I've already told family and friends that THIS is my resort of choice!

reviews.author: pauldB5201VH
reviews.title: Horrible Place
reviews.text: I stayed here from the day after Thanksgiving until December 3rd and while the staff was friendly and very nice overall when i ran into a incident on my last day there the service and resolution was HORRIBLE and left a bad taste in my mouth. They planned a remodel above my room with no notice ? and when i went downstairs and asked that they delay it until i check out the next day they said yes and right after lunch the construction started again.i ended up having to move and my room was downgraded with a measly offer of a 20 minute welcome massage when i had already spent about $ 500 US dollars at the Spa during my stay. having a lot of knowledge of the hospitality industry i know that this was planned and the lack of consideration of PUTTING THE GUEST FIRST is beyond me. I would not stay here again or suggest to anyone else.i filed a formal complaint in writing to management on December 3rd and and as of December 31st have not gotten a reply.

reviews.author: koralart
reviews.title: I loved it !
reviews.text:
I enjoyed every minute of my stay in this hotel. Amstar transportation was reliable and reasonable.The room was cold enough to feel comfortable and not to be affected by humidity. Not intrusive cleaning personnel. My minibar was refilled every day without hustle. Food was EXCELLENT!!!  NAOS buffet never bored me with selection and varieties of meals. The staff really took pride in serving guests needs. Gaudencio and Pablo greeted me every day with a willingness to make my dining experience nothing less than superb! I would rate the food as healthy and nutritional. All restaurants offered great experience and quality of food and service, but I would mention "VENTO" (Gerardo guided me through an unfamiliar menu like an A grade skipper)."ILBANA"(The art of sharing) was elegant and memorable , especially with help of a waiter Claudio. I loved all bars and promptness with which drinks were served. Pool bar became my favorite. 
Entertainment was also good. Great and enthusiastic dancers and singers. M. Jackson was the best.
Marco and Blanca were always ready to help and guide. All in all, I had a great experience and strongly recommend this hotel. Definitely will be back!

reviews.author: Deonesea
reviews.title: Amazing Entertainment!
reviews.text: Not only was the hotel gorgeous with wonderful restaurants and gracious staff, but the nightly entertainment was superb!  As a dancer myself, I had a great time enjoying and connecting with the entertainers.  I was impressed with their creativity, their choreographies and their costuming...they had their audiences enthralled.  And it was great fun dancing Salsa and Bachata with them by the pool during dance lessons.  Thank you Rodrigo, Chacho, Hugo, Fernando, Freddy and the ladies for a truly fun time!!

reviews.author: nking225
reviews.title: AMAZING RESORT
reviews.text: This place has everything you could think of having. The beach is amazing and it gets better when you upgrade to the Royal Service.....because you get exactly what its called "ROYAL SERVICE. There are soooo many restaurants and activities to choose from. The YHI Spa is something out of this world. The food in any of the restaurants was AWESOME....I will definitely be a repeat visitor.

reviews.author: Tito Tim Travels
reviews.title: Woderful hotel - great service!
reviews.text: I stayed here quite some time ago - but what an unforgettable experience. Yes, it is far from the main road, but that is not a problem for me. I enjoy the walk, if you do not... take a taxi?  :)  When I first got into the lobby I was a bit concerned about the humidity. If you have seen the pics of the luscious plants, well, it is kind of like a greenhouse.  Glass pyramids, lots of sun, lots of water for the plants.  But my concern was unwarranted. The shops, offices, restaurants and bars are properly air conditioned.  The room was great!  I had a odd corner  of the pyramid with a partial ocean view and partial lagoon view.  It was great.  The bathroom was big, and properly equipped. Big tub, amazing shower, separate room for the toilet and bidet. Hard to find such nice fixtures in an American hotel.  The concierge service was so helpful! I usually don't use a concierge but they were so friendly and chatted with me throughout my week. Then they gave the best advice on tours and restaurants.

reviews.author: Benita J
reviews.title: Mexico
reviews.text: Staff was wonderful, especially David, bus driver are not helpful, almost had me some where I didn't want to be. Nice young lady helped me get back to Melia Paradisus hotel, after boat ride on the Marina. I would have been lost without her. Food was great, enjoyed each restaurant. Drinks were good, all inclusive the best. Very hot and humid, enjoyed my tan.

reviews.author: KenpoDC
reviews.title: PARADISUS enjoyed it and would certainly go back!
reviews.text:
I wanted to start off by talking about The building five desk: Veronica at the desk in building number 5 was VERY helpful in making reservations, providing information and just overall really making a good attempt at making the stay pleasant. Veronica is a very friendly person, very, very beautiful on the inside and outside.  She is a stellar employee and I'm grateful for all the help she provided. 

The food: 

The restaurant Enso, which is billed as an Asian fusion was a drastic disappointment in quality of food. Everything we ordered was quite disappointing. The service was great, the staff very friendly but the food I give a D+.  The only redeeming thing was this Pineapple/orange/Lychee/Strawberry vanilla punch they had. That was good, the rest for get it, skip this place. 

La palapa, now that place had good food. Well worth it. The food was quite good with a wonderful presentation. With a table overlooking the water, it was an experience worth remembering. Again the staff was very friendly and accommodating. We went here four times it was that good. 

Mole: The food was not great, not bad, just ok. The dish I had was quite sweet, so sweet that it drowned out the shrimp. The sea bass was also overwhelmed by all the activity that was occurring on top of it. The topping was just too strong, the fish was lost in the ocean of favors. Alejandro was extremely helpful, cheerful and completely willing to go above and beyond. He was great. He was so versatile that he was almost like our private concierge for an hour. He kept checking in on is to be sure our experience was a good one. What a great employee. The hostess Ana, was very pleasant, very helpful, friendly and really went the extra mile. Ana was extremely attentive. She and Alejandro made the lack-luster food worth coming. The staff was great, but the food not so much. 

I'm going to give barro an -A. Good solid sushi, you can't go wrong here.  The staff was wonderful. The hostess beautiful on the inside and outside. The bar tender was fantastic. Friendly, creative and funny. He made a drink up for me out of his own mind that was fantastic. I asked him to make me something unusual, weird and fruity and he delivered! 

The market Grille in the restaurant buffet attached to it were OK I would give them a B. They do need some upgrades though in the buffet area. It was pretty good, not great, just good. 

The café seating area in the building number five (5) section was fantastic. The food provided was great the drink selection was optimal the Koi pond was gorgeous the ivy was incredible and artistic and beautiful. I love the selection of cheeses and meats and the breakfast items were fantastic. The selection of desserts in the evening was scrumptious. Good job on this part of the resort! 

At times it was hard to get in to some of the restaurants as thy book up all I gut Carly quickly. 

The Pool area: 

The staff outside in the pool area also were extremely friendly with Omar always going above and beyond with helping us out.  He was friendly and funny. The only downside to the pool area is I think that there should be more lounge chairs. The cabana are at a premium and sometimes difficult to secure leaving only the ability to relax with a lounge chair and I just don't think that they were enough. I also think that more lounge chairs are needed on the beach and that there should be the music playing out there on the beach as well. Why no speakers pointing out to the water? 

The front desk and Bell staff:

Johnathan at the bel-stand, was friendly, accommodating, and very helpful in getting on the shuttle. The front desk and concierge staff were always helpful and friendly. 

The Spa:

We enjoyed the spa and had a lovely time in there. The staff was very friendly and accommodating inside the spa area. Facilities were lovely I would just like to see a little bit more of a selection of health related food items in the spa area where the drinks are.

One thing that bothers me is there there should be more places to make change so we can tip properly.  It was always an adventure to get change. I think some of the amenities close too early. It's very bothersome to see the staff in long pants and shirts when it's so hot. Especially outside. At a minimum, everyone working outside or who goes in and out should be in shorts and short sleeve shirts and the women should be allowed to wear skirts if they want to. It is just horrible seeing the staff in those clothes. One thing I would like to know, is why in the world does hotel management make their poor staff wear long pants and 3/4 length or long sleeve shirts when the temperature is close to unbearable. At times it was a heat index of over 100 degrees outside. The heat and humidity are nothing to shrug a shoulder to as they are intense. It's unfair and makes me feel so badly for them. They walk around with smiles and wonderful attitudes, as friendly and pleasant as anyone could ever want someone to be. It's unbelievable that management thinks it's ok to subject their staff to wearing clothing that is not suited for the weather. 

Overall it was a fantastic experience and I would certainly go back. If I go to the area again, I wouldn't stay anywhere other than the Paradisus.

reviews.author: Steve B
reviews.title: Vacation getaway
reviews.text: I visited the hotel for 7 nights in May 2016...so I'm a little late to post my first review. Overall, the hotel was great...from the time of arrival to departure. All hotel staff was pleasant and very willing to accommodate. I enjoy traveling alone and this trip has been one of the best. The all inclusive restaurants were great. One restaurant is a buffet while others are a la carte. The staff was polite and attentive...from Pamela (hostess) at Market Grill, Wilbert at the breakfast buffet or Alan at the pool bar...each one of the remembered where I liked to sit, how I like my coffee or drinks at the pool. I was very impressed...especially knowing that they could remember it all after having a party of 900 come thru that morning. Rooms were clean with turn down service. Alcohol included in all inclusive is what other hotels would consider top shelf (Johnny Walker Black, Don Julio, Glenlivet, etc. I would definitely stay there again.

reviews.author: ruthh609
reviews.title: Beautiful, environmentally friendly resort
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach I've ever seen.  The spa and gym were excellent, food was superb.  The pool was also very nice.  The classes were nice, water aquatics and Zumba classes.  The evening entertainment was fun, though I only went to one show.  The staff was very nice.  They even take care of the sea turtles that lay their eggs on the beach!

reviews.author: shelleyt432
reviews.title: Miss u guys already
reviews.text: Couples but my husband couldnt go. I was nervous.. After i got there.. It was anazing.. I was sobsafe.. They called me by my last nar.. Eatched iut for me. I felt like oprah! Im coming back in oct. he is too!

reviews.author: StormCrow2
reviews.title: Amazing hotel and service!
reviews.text: The last time I stayed at this hotel was before they added on the two new pyramids. I can say that they have made this place even better! The service was outstanding from the time I arrived until the time I left! Pablo at Naos and the crew at the beach side bar in the evenings, and housekeeping went above and beyond to make my stay special. The hotel has a great scent that varies from pyramid to pyramid. I highly recommend to anyone for excellent food, exceptional service, and a beautiful well-maintained hotel!

reviews.author: Averagegal11
reviews.title: A little slice of paradise
reviews.text:
I did an all inclusive stay here and it was fabulous. The food selection and quality was fabulous, the grounds were beautiful, the weather was amazing. If you have the opportunity to swim with the dolphins while you are there, do it. That was outstanding.
I would absolutely do another all inclusive trip here again.

reviews.author: 190irist
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text:
This is truly a paradise resort! Beautiful setting, good food (though I did not like the quality in all restaurants, some others were indeed wonderful and there is enough to pick from.) fun entertainment. 
And the service is superb!

The only thing I missed is a bit more culture. The resort is very far away from "real" Mexico and though they offer a lot of trips to natural, eco and water activities, there are no trips to see Mexican culture, at least none that I saw.

reviews.author: jane b
reviews.title: stunning resort & beach!
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort with an abundance of plants, vines and trees inside as well as a fish pond, flowing water and a glass ceiling high above it all. Lovely wooden walkways and furniture all immaculately kept with cleaners working 24/7. The resort was spotless inside and out at all times, the staff were extremely polite, and the atmosphere was wonderful.
Truly a 5 star resort. 

My favourite restaurant was the Market Grill. It serves food in a dim sum style - yet the food is not asian!  They come around with steak, roast beef, chicken, potatoes, vegetables, salad etc etc. Tasted fantastic!

The reason i give the resort a 4 instead of a 5 was the noise level in our room in the evenings (this was in the main pyramid #3). Unfortunately the music permeated into my room on the 3rd floor as if I had the door open. 

The only other mild complaint was that the coffee bar had kind of useless hours (10am - 10pm). But really.......if that is all i could complain about, thats pretty awesome.

I would totally recommend this resort. I had an amazing time. And it was so so clean you could have eaten off the floors both inside and out.

reviews.author: Shanna F
reviews.title: Loved every moment in Paradise!
reviews.text: I enjoyed the set up of the whole place, the service, the food, it was all wonderful! Friendly and helpful staff. The spa was great! It was a pleasure to be there and would definitely go again! The pool's were amazing and everything was so clean and well tended to.

reviews.author: JENNIFER L. BURNS
reviews.title: April 2016
reviews.text:
Overall was a fab experience!  Great value for price!  Customer service was great!  Layout with all food choices was wonderful.  They were very a conidati g on food allergies and sensitivities!  Wow!  These guys at market grill were great!

reviews.author: NimoKelly
reviews.title: Incredible service and luxury
reviews.text: Can't recommend it highly enough! Can't fault a thing! The staff were so attentive and nice, the surroundings were so beautiful and the food, music and atmosphere were outstanding! The entertainment at the beach, pool and in the red lounge were fantastic!

reviews.author: bobdQ6790BO
reviews.title: Most amazing trip with amazing manifesters
reviews.text: I knew I would have fun, but it was so much more than that. Amazing people everywhere and the best service imaginable. Unbelievable parties, wonderful food, relaxing beach, and awesome swim up bar! And I met an amazing woman who just blew me away! How does it get any better?

reviews.author: Karin S
reviews.title: Wonderful hotel
reviews.text: Great service, Asuncion the waitress by the poolbar was absolutely great. The food was great. Everything was wonderful. The beach is beautiful, although a bit to wild to swim in. I had a great room in the familyconcierge building.

reviews.author: Compass39969

Paradisus offers everything you're looking for without ever leaving the premises in an innovative indoor garden jungle setting on glorious full-luxury service beaches.

reviews.author: tgoble1972
reviews.title: You will love this place!
reviews.text: Tons to do! I will definitely go back. The only reason I didn't give it a 10, our dinner reservations were lost 2x but could of been lost in translation. Plenty of places to eat! I also didn't know I didn't have the right color bracelet to eat in this one area and was told to move. I asked if I could eat first then I'd move and he said no, get your stuff and move now. We had dance parties by the pool and so many fun things to do. If you stayed there and didn't go anywhere else it would never get boring. I will go back someday and will KNOW not to sit in that area so then my experience will be a 10 for sure!
